title: The reeve offers 'promise to seal the barrow once the king rests' before the game has told the player that the priest's blessing (the alternate way to open the barrow doors) requires being unpromised first; that tradeoff is spoken by the reeve himself only after the promise is already locked in ('The priest won't bless a door sworn shut, mind — ask him first if you want both'), and the innkeep's matching warning sits on a separate dialogue branch a player may visit afterward.
where: Vale of Ash / Last Light Square (talk to reeve, 'seal or open?')
